title: Financial Literacy Training Programme
summary: Financial Literacy Training Programme organised by Rotary Club of Mumbai Glocal at Rishi Valmiki Eco School, Manori chaired by Rtn Chetan Budhia and attended by Rtn Rajendran Unnikrishnan.
description:
Financial Literacy Training Programme organised by Rotary Club of Mumbai Glocal at Rishi Valmiki Eco School, Manori chaired by Rtn Chetan Budhia and attended by Rtn Rajendran Unnikrishnan. The programme was designed for both students and teachers, with the objective of taking financial literacy beyond textbooks and introducing practical money-management skills that can be applied in everyday life.

The sessions for both students as well as the teachers were conducted in an interactive and activity-driven format, encouraging participants to think, question and relate financial concepts with practical approach.
